title: Store model provider keys and set spend limits
description: A separate OpenAI key for this account and a second image provider, stored as SSM SecureString parameters. Set spend limits at the providers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 2026-11-11: reuse the Papyrus development OpenAI and TypeSafe keys rather than new ones. Stored as SecureString parameters /papyrus/the-hallucinator/openai-api-key and /papyrus/shared/typesafe-api-key (the default names Papyrus reads). Not done: spend limits at the providers (shared with the Anthus sites, so a limit there covers both), a second image provider, and Amplify secrets (they need the Amplify app first).
